notes: Follow-up to 13886 (permissions tab cold-load fetch lifecycle). Local testing showed /ql/checklist/phan-quyen still hung indefinitely on 'Dang tai ho so quyen...' with 0/0/0 counters, never resolving. Root cause: NOT a stuck request/promise - both the grants fetch (refreshChecklistPermissions) and the employees fetch (fetchLatestChecklistPeopleData, wired in 13885) complete successfully over the network. The bug is a DOM selector mismatch in the re-render callbacks 13884/13885 added inside refreshChecklistPermissions() and ensureChecklistPermissionsOnSettings(): both used root.querySelector('[data-phfck-workspace]') to find the container to update - but [data-phfck-workspace] only exists in the ADMIN dashboard's own DOM shell (created once, admin-only, in the top-level admin template). The manager route's DOM tree never contains that attribute at all; its equivalent container is [data-phfck-manager-content] (see updateManagerSectionView(), which already correctly used it). So on the manager route those callbacks silently found `null`, `if(workspace)` skipped, and the successful fetch response was simply discarded - the loading UI never got replaced. Verified this codebase already has the exact fix pattern established elsewhere (line ~3965: reportWorkflowReload's re-render already does `root.querySelector('[data-phfck-workspace]')||root.querySelector('[data-phfck-manager-content]')`) - reused that same OR-fallback, did not invent a new selector-resolution helper. Fixed in assets/js/checklist/phf-checklist-app.js: both success/error branches in refreshChecklistPermissions() and both then()/catch() branches in ensureChecklistPermissionsOnSettings() now use the OR-fallback selector. Also closed a related error-handling gap surfaced by the same investigation: permissionTableHtml()'s loading gate could not tell 'still loading' apart from 'employees fetch genuinely failed' (checklistPeopleDataReady() never becomes true on failure, so without reading peopleDataSyncState.lastError the UI would hang on the loading spinner FOREVER on a real error, not just while pending) - it now reads peopleDataSyncState.lastError alongside the existing grants pd.error, shows which of the two sources failed, and renders a data-phfck-permission-retry button wired to the same ensureChecklistPermissionsOnSettings(root,true) pipeline (no new/forked retry path). Regression: scripts/test-checklist-permissions-tab-guard.js extended with structural checks for the selector fallback (would have caught this before local testing) and the error-vs-loading distinction (38 checks total). No backend/SQL/preset/capability changed, no setTimeout added, no gate bypassed, no 403 relaxed, Admin behavior unchanged (Admin's DOM already had [data-phfck-workspace], so its lookups always succeeded - this was purely a manager-route bug), Workflow Summary (13882/13883) untouched.
